about.label: THE PERSON BEHIND THE PIXELS
about.lead: Good technology should feel simple, even when the thinking behind it isn't.
paragraphs: I'm a curious developer from Gujarat, India, interested in building across the web — from clean interfaces and responsive frontends to APIs, databases and the logic that connects everything.
I value clear communication, steady learning and practical problem-solving. Outside the code editor, you'll find me exploring design details, learning new tools or enjoying a strong cup of chai.

projects.title: SafarSetu
projects.desc: A travel discovery concept bringing transport, stays, food and local experiences together in one simple journey planner.

caseStudy.problem: Travelers in India often have to toggle across 5-6 apps for state transport, local homestays, hidden food gems, and cultural attractions.
caseStudy.solution: SafarSetu aggregates unified itineraries with vernacular language support, interactive offline maps, and cost estimators for group travelers.
features: Interactive itinerary planner with drag-and-drop days
Local homestays and community culinary trails
Offline caching for low connectivity remote areas

projects.title: VH Taxi Go
projects.desc: An EV rental and ride-booking prototype exploring passenger and driver workflows, trip updates and verification.

caseStudy.problem: EV fleet operators struggle with vehicle battery range forecasting and synchronous driver-rider dispatching.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered a real-time tracking engine using Socket.io and Redis geospatial indexes that computes accurate battery endurance alongside route pricing.
features: Live vehicle telematics and telemetry simulator
Instant driver assignment via nearest-radius indexing
Secure JWT authentication with role-based access control
Trip verification QR codes and automated invoicing

projects.title: Cricket Analytics
projects.desc: A cricket data exploration dashboard concept for turning match information into useful insights for players and analysts.

caseStudy.problem: Grassroots coaches and tournament organizers lack access to interactive ball-by-ball analysis tools used by elite teams.
caseStudy.solution: Developed a high-performance analytics portal processing historical ball-by-ball IPL and Ranji Trophy metrics with interactive wagon wheels and pitch heatmaps.
features: Interactive strike-rate vs dot-ball ratio comparison
Player match-up predictor against bowler types
Custom tournament leaderboards and PDF match reports
Fast SQL indexing for million-record query responses

projects.title: PixRevive
projects.desc: A photo restoration application concept focused on helping people preserve and revisit meaningful memories.

caseStudy.problem: Old family vintage photographs suffer from color fading, creasing, and noise degradation over generations.
caseStudy.solution: Created an accessible browser tool where users can upload heritage photos, preview side-by-side restoration filters, and repair scratches with client-side canvas shaders and AI backends.
features: Colorization pipeline with skin-tone fidelity adjustments
Zero-retention private processing guaranteeing user privacy
